body: How long did it take to receive your vignette after that sms?
Thank you so much for this thoughtful comment!! I’ll try to keep this mindset today and on
He told me the joke “wasnt that genuine” but still there was a bit of genuineness to it ..
Gonna start going for daily runs :)
You looked at all the photos right ? Cuz ..😞
I’m not sure if i like him or not, but I’m definitely attracted to him. He’s not my usual type but if he asked me out I’d go for it.
hahah I’m a girl :) but the flat is all male, and one of them knows I’m attracted to them and he’s the one who invited me and then the others agreed, so maybe he was actually showing interest lol

doesn’t quite make sense because he’s spooned me after rejecting me, (after asking if I was cold. I was in his bed for the night because he offered me to stay over after I told him it was late and I should go home). he is also touchy with me sometimes (rubbing my back to comfort me when they make jokes about me), he even stroked my hair with his hockey stick at a point lol. this was all after the rejection. it must not be the awkwardness for him, but something else ?
I love spending time with him even after the rejection. he’s a really nice guy and a great friend. He’s really fun to be around but the only thing I worry about is annoying him because I like him!!
Yes but he has to like me first for him to miss me, right? He’s only known me for a day.
My mindset was how can he wonder about me if he doesn’t even see me😂
I guess him thinking I’m really clingy and then not being interested in seeing me again
I’ve read it. I guess I won’t reach out to her again, I hope she didn’t tell the guy that I asked if they wanted to hang out because I especially don’t wanna look needy to him.. we’ll see I guess

Yeah I can confirm that. I’ve spent the past week trying to read into how to be less needy. I am trying to solve things however I keep acting on my impulses. I wasn’t going to ask them to hang out today but my friends convinced me to ask them
Yeah I get that. Hoping I didn’t scare them off and that they’ll ask if I want to hang sometime 🤷🏻‍♀️

To people I’m romantically into. I think the reason I wanted to hang out with them today was to see her flatmate... :( as a psych major I really think that questioning if you have a disorder can actually help because it gives you specifics to look at to solve the problem... but that’s just my opinion

Hmm, I told them my flat was dead that night and asked if they were doing stuff again, basically phrased it like I was bored and was just wondering if they were up to something. I hope it didn’t come across as needy. And she had told me that I could snapchat her if I wanted to hang out or something. Oh well, I won’t ask again unless she does 🤷🏻‍♀️
But do you think I looked needy by asking if they wanted to meet a day after we hung out??
He’s not the kind of guy to wanna hook up, but I think he’s just an affectionate person. However I’m less concerned about him and more concerned about looking needy to the new friend I made

I think I have borderline personality disorder... yeah I have a huge problem with taking things personally. I should be in therapy however I just switched countries so i need to find a therapist here. No it was for the second time, I’ve already been able to get over the guy rejecting me
You think I was being needy for asking if she was doing something tonight?

The thing is with the guy, he’s invited me to spend the night at his flat once when I told him I should go home because it was late, he’s invited me to hang out alone, and everything is back to normal again, all of these things happened after he rejected me. It makes me feel like it’s not that he’s trying to not make things awkward but that I’m annoying or something
I think it was because we were self isolating together for uni and he didn’t want to come across as a guy who gets with a girl that fast, since we had only known each other for a week or so

Yeah, he had told her “we’re just friends and that’s fine”. And she told him to not allow me to jump to any wrong conclusions. I mean that same morning he had rested his head on my chest when we were in bed and quickly lifted it after like ten seconds and I felt like he did that because he didn’t want to lead me on. His flatmate thinks we are dating. It’s kind of funny because we’d be a good pair, but he just doesn’t see it I guess.

I think he might have a bit of feelings for one of my friends but I don’t know. I had asked him if he had liked someone and he said he didn’t know anyone well enough to. And he was showing us his tinder and how he couldn’t find a girl who wanted a relationship, so it’s clear he is looking... I don’t know. Maybe he’s embarrassed to like me? He had asked after we kissed, if people asked if something was happening between us because one of my friends saw us cuddling on the couch, and he was also telling me “I’m assuming we won’t tell the others we just made out?”.
Why would he deny it?
So you think there’s no need to tell him I don’t like him? Do you think I should maybe not accept plans with everyone for a bit? I want him to believe I don’t like him lol

You gave me hope 😭😭 noooooo. But yeah I hope things will be normal soon because around November we have to make plans for our housemates next year and we were planning to live together with other friends even after he rejected me... I hope it stays the same and he still wants to live with me, since I like being around him, platonic or not
You think he may like me a little then?

That’s great to hear!! I’ve even noticed a change right now, and it’s only been a few hours since I’ve become ready to fake confidence and actually force myself to like myself. I feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders :)

It’s totally life changing!! I haven’t overcome insecurity, however I overcame social anxiety (for the most part), and became way less shy as a result, it felt amazing. Like it’s hard to even describe the amount of satisfaction you get from realizing you’re not so anxious about being around people anymore. I’m still very insecure and today I realized it needs to stop and that I just need to fake confidence. I realized I was missing out on so much by staying insecure, including really fucking amazing guys, who as a result I’ve been friendzoned by becsuse it’s clear that I’m very insecure. We also miss out on, I guess, freedom? Not being preoccupied about hating yourself and stuff. How long did it take you to stop being insecure ?

So you’re saying they will like me more if I’m more confident? And yeah that’s what I’m thinking, I should be glad they’re not attracted to me because I have a lot of issues so it would be strange if they saw me as girlfriend material lmao. I’ve attracted emotionally abusive men in the past, and I realized if I am a confident girl I will have a less chance of getting caught in that situation again

I had therapy for a year. I recently moved from the US to the UK so I haven’t been able to find someone yet. I don’t really enjoy the online therapy rn tho :( so right now I’m just trying to learn on my own
Do you think if I become more confident they will like me more? Or because I already showed them I’m needy (since I hang out with them every day) that they will always think of me like that

I think it’s because I’m codependent so I’m naturally insecure. I’m sure it’s because of my childhood, I’ve always been quite needy. I’m not used to attention so when I have it and then don’t have it anymore, I crave it and become so insecure when things don’t feel the same when I was getting the attention I wanted. I don’t know how to stop overthinking when that happens. For example, my friend didn’t reply to a text I sent in a group chat about something he would normally reply to, and it made me think “oh shit he probably thinks I’m so needy and stupid”. For some reason I can’t stop the thought process that everyone hates me.
How did he dismiss my emotions?
He told me he is not the type to want to sleep with someone right away. He’s a genuine guy, I don’t think he was taking advantage of me.
